quotes.quote: I usually use gitlab though and I felt "put off" by all their native AI features being license gated.
quotes.excerpt: I use hermes with crons and kanban for this. I have a "self driving" homelab where upgrades & config changes happen in a non-prod ct before being applied to "prod" (just, a diff ct). Its mainly compose stacks with data volumes on zfs that gets snapshotted a lot to limit possible data loss. I use the orchestrator to break down regular tasks like "health check the whole env" or "find all containers that need an update"
